class.name: PlayerMove
class.brief_description: An extension of [CharacterBody3D] to process movement input.
class.description: This class moves the [CharacterBody3D] base class based on the Input Actions [code]Left, Right, Forward, Backward[/code] at a rate less than [param Max Speed].

argument.name: delta
argument.description: Sets [Vector2] [param moveDirection] based on the Input Actions [code]Left, Right, Forward, Backward[/code].

argument.name: delta
argument.description: Calculates the velocity with SUVAT equations. If [param Player Look] is [code]NULL[/code] then forces are local to the PlayerMove class instead of the PlayerLook class. This function also calculates movement friction using [param Moving Friction] coefficient and the inital velocity.

method.name: print_type
method.description: Print the type of the variant.

members.member: Max player movement speed in Units/sec. The player velocity is clamped to this AFTER friction calulation (innacurate but lets player actually reach [param Max Speed]).
Reference to the [PlayerLook] node on the player. If not set, movement will be relative to the [PlayerMove] class instead.
